title: Playboy April 1987 Women of TV's Casanova Rae Dawn Chong Complete w/ Centerfold
condition_description: Covers clean and bright with no creases or tears; spine intact. Light edge wear. Complete with centerfold. See photos.
description:
Playboy magazine, April 1987 issue, original $3.50 cover price. Complete with centerfold.

Cover features: The Women of TV's "Casanova"; Death at Dawn: How CBS Killed Its Morning News; Jeans Too Hot for Ads; Rae Dawn Chong tells what's hot (and what's not); Greed and Grit on Wall Street - an exclusive interview with Louis Rukeyser.

Back cover: Benson & Hedges ad.

Adult collectible - sold to buyers 18+ only. See photos for condition. Ships in a plain, protective mailer.
